title: EVALUATING A SYNTHETIC IMAGE DATASET GENERATED WITH STABLE DIFFUSION
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the general capability of the Stable Diffusion model to generate classifiable synthetic images for a wide range of concepts from the Wordnet taxonomy.
